text:
Priya N.: Dropping a compact roadmap proposal for the Efficiency Advisor (batching, prefix/KV cache hints, quant suggestions, light eval alerts). Need quick alignment on MVP cut + GA gates.
Carlos M.: Short and practical — can we focus MVP on patterns with highest wins: chat streams, mobile short prompts, and embedding pipelines?
Priya N.: Yes. MVP features proposed:
- route-level batching "autosuggest" (based on request rate + token histograms)
- prefix/KV cache hints with TTL and expected hit-rate estimate
- non-invasive quant suggestion engine (recommend only, no auto-convert)
- eval-alerts v0: warning-only for regressions (no auto-fallback)
Dana S.: Important: every quant suggestion must include recommended rollback steps and a tiny verification test that SEs can run. Also show an estimated cost delta in Console before they flip anything.
Victor: For autosuggest heuristics: inputs = p50/p90 token length, requests/sec, current p95/p99 latency, and sample utilization. Output = batch size + expected p99 delta + confidence score. I'll sketch formulas.
Carlos M.: UX: show both "estimated cost change" and "estimated quality risk" in a short line. Example: "~14% cost down, low risk (conf=0.81)". Helps SEs decide.
Priya N.: Launch gates sketch:
- stability: internal synthetic workload p99 within 7% baseline for 24h
- correctness: quant unit + integration tests for representative model families pass
- observability: Console shows econ/risk estimator for top N routes
- pilot: at least one external or internal beta (1% traffic x 72h) with A/B metrics OR internal-only if SLIs are met
- eval-alerts: implemented for internal eval sets (warning mode)
Dana S.: Signals for eval-alerts: concordance on golden prompts, n-gram overlap, embedding cosine drift. Two severities: warning (ops ticket) and urgent (manual review).
Priya N.: Ops policy note: Hosted should default to manual review + notify for now. Dedicated/Private get opt-in auto-fallback toggles per deployment. We must document ownership and escalation path.
Victor: Acceptance criteria for pilots: user-visible regressions <= 3% in A/B for key metrics, and rollback completes within 30 minutes if breached.
Carlos M.: Also require that the Console estimator gives a breakdown: token-level cost, batching impact, and quant delta. Keep the UI microcopy simple.
Dana S.: Action items:
- Priya: publish one-page roadmap + owners (deadline Wed)
- Victor: heuristics + simple formula sketch (Tue)
- Carlos: 2 tiny mockups for Console econ/risk blurbs (Mon)
- Dana: eval sets list + A/B metric definitions (Tue)
- All: approve alpha rollout window or raise blockers by EOD today
ops-bot: Proposed alpha window: 2026-04-11 02:00 UTC. React with :thumbsup: to approve.
Priya N.: Thanks. I'll push the doc to https://redwood.internal/docs/eff-advisor-mvp and set a short sync. If no objections, we start infra/runbook handoffs next week. :white_check_mark:
